nora_devex: Heads-up: ran into an odd parity bug between the sync and async Python clients. The sync client retries a POST create and sets Idempotency-Key automatically when you pass idempotency_key=, but the async client ignores that param and retries without the header. Caused a duplicate resource in a demo.

paul_sdk: that sounds bad. which SDK version and small repro?

nora_devex: python-sdk 1.0.1. Minimal repro below: sync helper works as expected, async helper doesn't set the header on replay.

nora_devex: ```python
# sync (works)
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="sk-test", timeout=2.0)
resp = c.post("/v1/orders", json={"item":"x"}, idempotency_key="k-sync-1")
print(resp.status_code)

# async (broken)
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def run():
    ac = AsyncClient(api_key="sk-test", timeout=2.0)
    r = await ac.post("/v1/orders", json={"item":"x"}, idempotency_key="k-async-1")
    print(r.status)

asyncio.run(run())
```

nora_devex: Logs show sync request includes Idempotency-Key on retry; async one retries but Authorization + Idempotency-Key missing on the replay attempt.

tim_infra: paste trimmed logs?

nora_devex: logs snippet:

```
Sync attempt 1 -> Headers: Authorization, Idempotency-Key: k-sync-1
Sync 1 -> 502
Sync retry -> Headers: Authorization, Idempotency-Key: k-sync-1 -> 201

Async attempt 1 -> Headers: Authorization, Idempotency-Key: k-async-1
Async 1 -> 502
Async retry -> Headers: (Authorization present), Idempotency-Key: MISSING -> 201 (duplicate created)
```

paul_sdk: hmm. two separate issues could cause this: (1) async helper isn't wiring idempotency_key into the per-call headers that the retry replays, or (2) async retry reconstruction discards per-call kwargs. Also need to check that auth middleware is applied consistently.

sue_pm: customer impact? This affected a demo but could hit customers. Severity P2.

nora_devex: mitigation: set explicit headers on every async call or disable auto-retries for non-idempotent endpoints. Both are poor DX.

paul_sdk: I'll reproduce locally and open an issue. Plan: add unit test covering helper parity (sync vs async), ensure idempotency_key is propagated into replay metadata, and add typing tests so mypy/pyright catch signature mismatches between sync/async helpers. Also add quick docs note about default retry differences until fixed.

tim_infra: I'll add an integration CI check that runs both sync and async repros against the fake upstream and fails the build if headers diverge on retry.

paul_sdk: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/issues/3211 "async helper: preserve idempotency_key on retry (parity with sync)" and opened branch fix/async-idempotency-3211. Will include tests and changelog.

build-bot: CI: branch fix/async-idempotency-3211 pushed, reproducibility job queued.

nora_devex: added the tiny repro, logs, and demo trace to the issue. Thanks! :thumbsup:
